statements.statement: The patient has recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient's symptoms are poorly correlated with standard 24-hour Holter monitoring results
The patient has a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation
The patient has a history of cardiac arrhythmia
The diagnosis codes are I48.91 and I49.9
Prolonged cardiac event monitoring is indicated to capture intermittent symptomatic episodes and correlate them with rhythm disturbances
Less intensive monitoring options were attempted and failed prior to initiating this level of diagnostic testing
